title: vLLM - UCM Cache / Posix Store (CI)
description: UCM observability dashboard - cache/posix store module. Part of a set; the other UCM dashboards (tag: ucm) are linked from the header. CI variant: fixed datasource uid 'prometheus', `job` selector at the top to switch between CI environments.

panels.description: Fraction of load shards that missed the Cache buffer and had to descend to the backend (shard-level miss rate at load time). Equals rate(cache_load_backend_shards_total) / rate(cache_load_shards_total).

targets.expr:
sum by (${perWorker:raw}) (rate(ucm:cache_load_backend_shards_total{model_name="$model_name", job="$job", worker_id=~"$worker_id"}[$__rate_interval]))
/ clamp_min(
  sum by (${perWorker:raw}) (rate(ucm:cache_load_shards_total{model_name="$model_name", job="$job", worker_id=~"$worker_id"}[$__rate_interval])), 1
)

panels.title: Cache Backend Load Ratio

panels.description: Average end-to-end Cache load task duration. Series: p50 / p90 / p99 / avg, per worker.

targets.expr:
sum by (${perWorker:raw}) (rate(ucm:cache_load_duration_ms_sum{model_name="$model_name", job="$job", worker_id=~"$worker_id"}[$__rate_interval]))
/
sum by (${perWorker:raw}) (rate(ucm:cache_load_duration_ms_count{model_name="$model_name", job="$job", worker_id=~"$worker_id"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Cache Load Total Duration

panels.description: Average end-to-end Cache dump task duration. Series: p50 / p90 / p99 / avg, per worker.

targets.expr:
sum by (${perWorker:raw}) (rate(ucm:cache_dump_duration_ms_sum{model_name="$model_name", job="$job", worker_id=~"$worker_id"}[$__rate_interval]))
/
sum by (${perWorker:raw}) (rate(ucm:cache_dump_duration_ms_count{model_name="$model_name", job="$job", worker_id=~"$worker_id"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Cache Dump Total Duration

panels.description: Stacked average Cache load task duration. Uses task-level queue wait and dispatch metrics; WaitBackendTask + H2D is calculated as cache_load_duration_ms avg minus queue wait avg minus dispatch avg. Per-shard detail metrics are shown in detail panels and are intentionally not stacked here. Uses a fixed 40s rate window for stability.

targets.expr:
sum by (${perWorker:raw}) (rate(ucm:cache_load_queue_wait_duration_ms_sum{model_name="$model_name", job="$job", worker_id=~"$worker_id"}[40s]))
/
sum by (${perWorker:raw}) (rate(ucm:cache_load_queue_wait_duration_ms_count{model_name="$model_name", job="$job", worker_id=~"$worker_id"}[40s]))

sum by (${perWorker:raw}) (rate(ucm:cache_load_dispatch_duration_ms_sum{model_name="$model_name", job="$job", worker_id=~"$worker_id"}[40s]))
/
sum by (${perWorker:raw}) (rate(ucm:cache_load_dispatch_duration_ms_count{model_name="$model_name", job="$job", worker_id=~"$worker_id"}[40s]))

clamp_min(
  (
    sum by (${perWorker:raw}) (rate(ucm:cache_load_duration_ms_sum{model_name="$model_name", job="$job", worker_id=~"$worker_id"}[40s]))
    /
    sum by (${perWorker:raw}) (rate(ucm:cache_load_duration_ms_count{model_name="$model_name", job="$job", worker_id=~"$worker_id"}[40s]))
  )
  -
  (
    sum by (${perWorker:raw}) (rate(ucm:cache_load_queue_wait_duration_ms_sum{model_name="$model_name", job="$job", worker_id=~"$worker_id"}[40s]))
    /
    sum by (${perWorker:raw}) (rate(ucm:cache_load_queue_wait_duration_ms_count{model_name="$model_name", job="$job", worker_id=~"$worker_id"}[40s]))
  )
  -
  (
    sum by (${perWorker:raw}) (rate(ucm:cache_load_dispatch_duration_ms_sum{model_name="$model_name", job="$job", worker_id=~"$worker_id"}[40s]))
    /
    sum by (${perWorker:raw}) (rate(ucm:cache_load_dispatch_duration_ms_count{model_name="$model_name", job="$job", worker_id=~"$worker_id"}[40s]))
  ),
  0
)

panels.title: Cache Dump Avg Breakdown

panels.description: Wall-clock per-worker Cache load throughput in GB/s. Aggregates all concurrent Cache load tasks inside one worker process and includes idle gaps, so this is the real bytes/sec the worker is pulling through the Cache stage. Pair with (per task) above: high per-task with low per-worker means tasks are fast but sparse.
panels.title: Cache Load Bandwidth (aggregated)

panels.description: Wall-clock per-worker Cache dump throughput in GB/s. panels.title: Cache Dump MkBuf Duration

panels.description: Per-shard Cache load H2D async submit duration after WaitBackendTaskReady. This is recorded for each shard; it is not a task-level duration, does not include full task stream synchronization, and should not be stacked with total load, queue wait, or dispatch. Series: p50 / p90 / p99 / avg by selected view.

targets.expr:

panels.title: Cache Dump D2H Duration

panels.description: Per-shard Cache load WaitBackendTaskReady duration. For a miss this includes waiting for the backend load task; for a hit or shared buffer it captures readiness wait for that shard. This is not a task-level duration and should not be stacked with total load, queue wait, or dispatch. Series: p50 / p90 / p99 / avg by selected view.

targets.expr:
sum by (${perWorker:raw}) (rate(ucm:cache_shard_backend_wait_ms_sum{model_name="$model_name", job="$job", worker_id=~"$worker_id"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Cache Load Shard Backend Wait Duration

panels.description: Synchronous Cache dump backend submit duration around backend_->Dump(...). This is a submit cost only and does not include lower-tier disk write completion. Series: p50 / p90 / p99 / avg by selected view.

panels.description: Average Cache load bandwidth. Series: p50 / p90 / p99 / avg. Per-task observed Cache load throughput, sampled once per Cache load task as total task bytes divided by task wall-clock duration. This is not H2D-only bandwidth.

panels.description: Cache buffer lookup wall-clock time per `Lookup` / `LookupOnPrefix` call (fast path, in-memory hit/miss scan). Sub-millisecond is healthy; multi-millisecond means the scheduler is paying per-decision lookup overhead. Series: p50 / p90 / p99 / avg.

targets.expr:
sum by (${perWorker:raw}) (rate(ucm:cache_lookup_duration_ms_sum{model_name="$model_name", job="$job", worker_id=~"$worker_id"}[$__rate_interval]))
/
sum by (${perWorker:raw}) (rate(ucm:cache_lookup_duration_ms_count{model_name="$model_name", job="$job", worker_id=~"$worker_id"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Cache Lookup Duration

panels.description: Backend lookup time when descending due to no Cache buffer or buffer miss. Reflects the metadata-query latency of the lower tier (Posix / Ds3fs). Series: p50 / p90 / p99 / avg.

targets.expr:
sum by (${perWorker:raw}) (rate(ucm:cache_lookup_backend_duration_ms_sum{model_name="$model_name", job="$job", worker_id=~"$worker_id"}[$__rate_interval]))
/
sum by (${perWorker:raw}) (rate(ucm:cache_lookup_backend_duration_ms_count{model_name="$model_name", job="$job", worker_id=~"$worker_id"}[$__rate_interval]))

Cache / Load Duration
panels.description: End-to-end Cache load task duration distribution. Bimodal here often indicates a mix of Cache hits (fast) and misses descending to Posix. Cell value is request rate from rate(bucket), not raw request count; all workers aggregated.

panels.title: Cache / Load Bandwidth (per task)
panels.description: Effective Cache load bandwidth distribution. Cell value is request rate from rate(bucket), not raw request count; all workers aggregated. Per-task observed throughput, sampled once per Cache stage task (one task = one start_load_kv / dump_data batch). Aggregates shards within a task but NOT across concurrent tasks. Use the (per worker) panel below for actual per-worker throughput.

panels.title: Cache / Dump Duration
panels.description: Caller-felt Cache dump duration. Watch for convergence with Posix dump task duration -- back-pressure signal (see perf doc §3.4). Cell value is request rate from rate(bucket), not raw request count; all workers aggregated.

panels.title: Cache / Dump Bandwidth (per task)
panels.description: Effective Cache dump bandwidth distribution. Cell value is request rate from rate(bucket), not raw request count; all workers aggregated. Per-task observed throughput, sampled once per Cache stage task (one task = one start_load_kv / dump_data batch). Aggregates shards within a task but NOT across concurrent tasks. Use the (per worker) panel below for actual per-worker throughput.
